blind.B1: No for an exercise question. The only sequenced samples are C2C12 myotubes, Icariin 20 uM vs vehicle 24 h (S2.8.p1, S3.3.p1); no sample carries an exercise factor. Exercise (S2.2) is done in mice that were not sequenced; the caffeine exercise-like model (S2.4.p2) is not part of the RNA-seq. In-vitro drug series, not an exercise-mediator design.
blind.B2: Icariin 20 uM vs vehicle, n = 3 per group (S2.8.p1, S3.3.p1).
blind.B3: None: independent cell cultures; packet A lists no candidate pairing key.
blind.B4: Two-group comparison only, so joint vs pairwise does not arise; paper says DESeq2 without further model detail (S2.8.p1).
blind.B5: S2.8.p1: genes with |log2(Fold Change)| > 1 and adjusted p-value < 0.05 (strict >, FDR). Reported 1919 DEGs, 1134 up, 785 down (S3.3.p1).

checks.evidence: No exercise arm in the sequenced samples (S2.8.p1); refusal matches B1.
No DE run. 3 vs 3 Control/Icariin noted, matches paper n.
Recorded as none (independent cultures), consistent with B3.
Time aliased with treatment (control 24 h, Icariin 48 h per GEO overall design) is recorded in discrepancies; not checkable from packet A but consistent.
Only FPKM deposited vs DESeq2 in paper; recorded as not_evaluated.
paper_threshold padj 0.05, |log2FC| 1.0, inclusive false, S2.8.p1: matches B5.
No ours-vs-paper count claimed; HANDBACK states none and 1919 (1134/785) correctly.

Ownership refusal rests on organism, cell type, platform, feature IDs, timing contradicting S2.8.p1 (several independent checks, not a narrow search); no-exercise-arm claim holds per paper and packet A (no exercise words in any column).

human_items: Optional: the PMID-linked series holds rat vascular smooth muscle cells, not the paper's C2C12; authors could be asked whether the wrong dataset was deposited.
summary: 该系列没有运动组，论文的转录组仅为C2C12肌管 Icariin 对照比较，拒绝运行的决定正确。所有权拒绝的理由（物种、细胞类型、平台、基因ID、时间点均与论文不符）有多项独立证据支持。阈值转录与论文一致，未发现需要修改的项目。
